Name: Teleshopping - VietNamese
Author: khanhdang2701
Description:
[b]Description[/b]
Bring the excitement of TV shopping to Stardew Valley!
[b]Teleshopping Channel[/b] adds a brand-new TV channel to your farmhouse television, allowing you to shop from the comfort of your home. Every in-game week, the catalog is refreshed with [b]10 new products[/b], giving you plenty of reasons to tune in regularly and discover what's on sale.
Instead of visiting multiple shops around Pelican Town, simply turn on your TV, browse the current weekly catalog through a polished and immersive shopping interface, and place your order. Your purchases will be delivered the following morning in a vanilla-style package waiting right outside your farmhouse.
The entire experience has been carefully designed to blend seamlessly with Stardew Valley's original art style, user interface, and gameplay, making it feel like an official game feature.
[line]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download the latest release of [b]Teleshopping Channel[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into your:[/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code][list=1]
[*]Launch the game using [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Turn on your farmhouse TV and select the [b]Teleshopping[/b] channel.[/*]
[*]When updating from an older version, simply replace the existing mod folder with the new one.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Features[/b]
📺 Adds a brand-new [b]Teleshopping[/b] TV channel.
🛍️ Browse a clean, immersive, and user-friendly in-game shopping interface.
🔄 A fresh catalog of [b]10 new products every in-game week[/b].
💰 Dynamic pricing with configurable price multipliers.
🔍 Quickly find items using the built-in search bar.
📦 Orders are delivered the following morning in a vanilla-style package placed outside your farmhouse.
🌾 Designed to match Stardew Valley's original art style and gameplay.
🎮 Full support for mouse, keyboard, and controller.
🌐 Fully compatible with Multiplayer.
⚙️ Multiple configuration options for balancing and customization.
🧩 Automatically supports many items from other mods that are properly registered with Stardew Valley's Item Registry.
[line]
Requirements
[heading]Required[/heading]
[list]
[*]SMAPI (latest version)[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[/list][heading]Recommended[/heading]
While not required, this mod works especially well alongside content mods that add new crops, artisan goods, furniture, and other items. Eligible modded items can also appear in the weekly Teleshopping catalog, expanding the variety of products available.
